description: Paginate listMessages and listConversations. Both answer `paging: { cursors: { before, after }, next, previous }`; the spec models only `cursors`. Observed live on 2026-11-17 with limit=3 over 10 messages: `next` equals `cursors.after` while more pages remain and is null on the last page, where `cursors.after` is still set. So the next cursor is `paging.next`, passed back as `after`. Other list operations share the Paging shape but could not be observed (the sandbox answers 403 on them), and the ones that proxy Meta Graph return `next` as a URL, so they stay unpaginated.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Cursor for the next page, null on the last page. Pass it as `after`.
Cursor for the previous page, null on the first page. Pass it as `before`.
